data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic verb ‘farada’ which means to continue or to carry on, Farradah is a name that symbolizes the idea of perseverance and continuity. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farradah usually hope their child will grow to embody continuer, perpetuator and live with faith, good character and purpose.
